nina: Heads-up from onboarding: sampleapp + Node batch helper produced wrong embedding->query mapping when SDK retried. Scores ended up linked to the wrong ids.

omar: Can you share a tiny repro?

nina: Repro: sampleapp uses batcher that splits into chunks, sends them, and SDK auto-retries HTTP 502. When retry merges chunks back the concat sometimes reorders items. We log outgoing items as: [id:A, id:B, id:C] but backend sees [id:B, id:A, id:C] after retry. Consumer code matched by index so A/B swapped.

rita: Does the helper attach any stable index?

nina: No, current helper only uses array ordering. Quick mitigation: always include an explicit id and map responses by id rather than by index. Also validate vector dim per id before consuming.

omar: Filed DE-8150 to modify helpers (Node + Python): add per-item _seq, include id->position map in batch metadata, and make concat deterministic. Assigned to eng-runtime.

rita: Short-term: sampleapp PR will add a safety wrapper that maps by id and asserts dims.

devex-bot: DE-8150 created and linked to #eng-runtime.

nina: Note for onboarding checklist: "never assume positional alignment with retries; include stable ids and validate dims."

omar: Also adding integration test to CI that simulates token refresh + 502 + randomized reassemble.

rita: Thanks — pushing the sampleapp patch now.

nina: Resolving locally; follow DE-8150 for the runtime helper fix.
